items.title: Anthropic ships Claude Sonnet 5.5
items.body: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 on 28 Sep, the second model in the Claude 5.5 family. It scores 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (vs Sonnet 5 at 10.3% and Opus 5.5 at 66.4%), runs 30%+ faster, and costs up to 30% less per task at the same $2/$10 per MTok pricing through lower token use. It is now the free-tier default on claude.ai and carries cyber safeguards previously reserved for Opus-class models. Watch Haiku 5.5 in coming weeks and real-world agentic coding uptake.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 performance and safety details
items.body: Sonnet 5.5 reaches near-parity with Opus 5.5 on GDPval-AA (1844 vs 1846) and CursorBench 4.0 (55.5% vs 57.8%) while using fewer tokens. It is the first Sonnet with cyber safeguards and distillation classifiers. Simon Willison notes it is now the free-tier model, stronger than OpenAI's free offering. Early enterprise testers (Epic, Slack, Zendesk, Atlassian) report faster iteration and lower cost on coding and knowledge work.
